mapper.sql: join prd_wo w on w.wo_id = r.wo_id join prd_wo_proc wp on wp.wo_proc_id = r.wo_proc_id join mst_item i on i.item_id = w.item_id left join prd_result v on v.reversal_of_id = r.result_id left join mst_worker k on k.worker_id = r.performed_by left join mst_equip e on e.equip_id = r.equip_id left join lot_master l on l.lot_id = r.lot_id

count(*) as cnt, trim_scale(sum(r.good_qty)) as good_qty, trim_scale(sum(r.scrap_qty)) as scrap_qty, trim_scale(sum(r.rework_qty)) as rework_qty, trim_scale(sum(r.repair_qty)) as repair_qty, round(100 * (sum(r.scrap_qty) + sum(r.rework_qty) + sum(r.repair_qty)) / nullif(sum(r.good_qty + r.scrap_qty + r.rework_qty + r.repair_qty), 0), 2) as defect_rate

choose.when: select w.wo_no, i.item_cd, i.item_nm, r.unit_cd, from prd_result r and v.result_id is null group by w.wo_no, i.item_cd, i.item_nm, r.unit_cd

select w.wo_no, wp.op_seq, wp.proc_cd, wp.proc_nm, i.item_cd, i.item_nm, r.unit_cd, from prd_result r and v.result_id is null group by w.wo_no, wp.op_seq, wp.proc_cd, wp.proc_nm, i.item_cd, i.item_nm, r.unit_cd
select k.worker_cd, k.worker_nm, r.unit_cd, from prd_result r and v.result_id is null group by k.worker_cd, k.worker_nm, r.unit_cd
select r.work_day, r.shift_cd, r.unit_cd, from prd_result r and v.result_id is null group by r.work_day, r.shift_cd, r.unit_cd
choose.otherwise:
select r.result_id, r.work_day, r.shift_cd, w.wo_no, wp.op_seq, wp.proc_cd, wp.proc_nm, i.item_cd, i.item_nm, e.equip_cd, k.worker_cd, k.worker_nm, l.lot_no, trim_scale(r.good_qty) as good_qty, trim_scale(r.scrap_qty) as scrap_qty, trim_scale(r.rework_qty) as rework_qty, trim_scale(r.repair_qty) as repair_qty, r.unit_cd, r.occurred_at, r.recorded_by, v.result_id is not null as corrected, v.recorded_at as corrected_at, v.reason as correct_reason, aw.worker_cd as approver_cd, aw.worker_nm as approver_nm from prd_result r
left join pop_approval pa on pa.action_cd = 'RESULT_CORRECT' and pa.target_id = r.result_id left join mst_worker aw on aw.worker_id = pa.approver_worker_id

choose.when: order by worker_cd nulls last, unit_cd
order by work_day desc, shift_cd nulls last, unit_cd
choose.otherwise: order by work_day desc, result_id desc

mapper.select:
select * from () x order by
work_day shift_cd wo_no op_seq proc_cd item_cd equip_cd worker_cd lot_no occurred_at cnt good_qty scrap_qty rework_qty repair_qty defect_rate unit_cd
desc nulls last,
wo_no, item_cd, unit_cd wo_no, op_seq, unit_cd worker_cd nulls last, unit_cd work_day desc, shift_cd nulls last, unit_cd result_id desc
limit #{page.size} offset #{page.offset}

select d.kind, qd.defect_cd, qd.defect_nm, r.unit_cd, trim_scale(sum(d.qty)) as qty from prd_result r join prd_result_defect d on d.result_id = r.result_id join qms_defect qd on qd.defect_id = d.defect_id
and v.result_id is null group by d.kind, qd.defect_cd, qd.defect_nm, r.unit_cd order by d.kind, sum(d.qty) desc, qd.defect_cd
select worker_id from mst_worker where worker_cd = #{workerCd}
